newsitem.title: USA: US Servis says restraining order issued.
newsitem.headline: US Servis says restraining order issued.

text.p: US Servis Inc on Friday said the New York State Supreme Court issued a temporary restraining order stopping an affiliate of New York Health and Hospitals Corp from terminating its services agreement with the company.
The contract is with MetroPlus Health Plan, an affiliate of the New York City agency, US Servis said.
A hearing on US Servis' motion for a preliminary injunction was scheduled for July 2, the company said.

In its lawsuit, US Servis is trying to stop MetroPlus from terminating the pact and is seeking damages for breach of the agreement, the company said. It declined to specify the amount of damages it was seeking.
The contract in question was a three-year, $16 million agreement, which had 21 months left to run when the suit was filed last week.
Shares of US Servis, which provides financial and patient-information software for the health-care industry, were up 1/2 at 2-1/2 late Friday afternoon.
